title: Fame Fades, Nature Remains: Disentangling the Character Identity of Role-Playing Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the role-playing fidelity of LLMs when simulating famous characters (whose knowledge is embedded in pre-training data) versus newly generated synthetic characters across single-turn interviews and multi-turn interactions.

Classifying character profile fields (such as moral values, motivations, and interpersonal relationships) into positive and negative valences, and evaluating the performance degradation of LLMs when portraying characters with negative or conflictual attributes.
